component.name: Safe Disk Cleaner
component.summary: See where disk space is wasted and learn what is safe to delete

description.p: Safe Disk Cleaner finds wasted space on your Linux system and explains every item in plain language: what it is, why it grows, whether it is safe to delete and exactly what will run.

ul.li: Old kernels (always keeps the running kernel plus a fallback)
Package download caches (APT, DNF, pacman, zypper) and orphaned packages
Old Snap revisions and unused Flatpak runtimes
An oversized system journal, with an option to cap it permanently
Crash reports, core dumps and old rotated logs
Previews of files that no longer exist, app caches and the Trash

screenshot.caption: Overview: what can be cleaned, with a checkbox for each category
